title: ItBusinessProcess
description: IT ontology composite — materialization of the ontology.json axes for TogafBusinessProcess. Typing: extends TogafBusinessProcess (rootless — qualifier/data roles only). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's globally-unique title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — collision-free instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties). Mounted axes — attributed-to: ProvAttribution; measured-by-quality-in-use: Iso25000ProductContextCoverage, Iso25000ProductEffectiveness, Iso25000ProductEfficiency, Iso25000ProductFreedomFromRisk, Iso25000ProductSatisfaction. Source: frameworks/it/ontology.json (static materialization; generator planned).
